text:
andrew: Quick spike root cause: aggressive compact-on-idle is colliding with incoming short requests and spiking p99. Thinking tenant-scoped defrag credits + preemptible compaction token.

maria: Sketch the credits model.

andrew: Each tenant gets credits (ms/sec). Credits accumulate when idle up to cap. Evictor spends credits to compact; if exhausted, compaction must yield. Adds fairness and keeps compaction from stealing hotpath cycles.

lee: Need interrupt-safe compaction: chunk compaction (~64KB chunks) and persist progress in a per-slab journal so preempt/resume is safe.

xia: Token API idea:
```
string t = evictor.acquire_run_token(int want_ms, int tenant_id, int priority);
bool cont = evictor.token_heartbeat(t); // false -> stop and persist
```
This avoids heavy allocation-path locks.

maria: Telemetry: tenant_compaction_credit_ms, compaction_chunks_started/completed, compaction_aborts, preempt_heartbeats, small_req_p50/p95/p99_by_tenant.

xia: Prefetch nuance: request hint prefetch_profile:short|balanced|aggressive. Short => only probabilistic prefix prefetch to avoid kV pulls on short contexts.

andrew: Ops knobs: --tenant-defrag-credits-ms-per-sec, --global-defrag-window-ms, --compaction-chunk-bytes, --compaction-heartbeat-interval-ms, --compaction-max-run-ms. Per-tenant overrides.

lee: Rollout: behind feature flag -> 1% canary with verbose telemetry -> 10% -> enable autotune for cohort -> full. Add kill-switch.

maria: Correctness: compaction must be idempotent. Journal + versioned slab headers + unit tests that simulate random preemptions.

xia: Add pool-level fairness so noisy tenant can't hog compaction. Pool token-bucket with weights.
